tool.description: Core runtime tools: shell, files, memory, todo.

functions.name: exec
functions.description: Run a shell command on your computer. Use background=true for anything longer than a few seconds; its terminal result is delivered to you automatically when it finishes, so never poll for it.

timeout_s.description: Seconds before the command is killed. Default 60 foreground, 1800 background.

background.description: Return immediately with a session_id; the result arrives later.

functions.name: read
functions.description: Read a text file with paging. Paths resolve relative to ~.

functions.name: write
functions.description: Create or overwrite a text file. Parent directories are created.

functions.name: edit
functions.description: Replace an exact string in a file once. The old string must match exactly and be unique.

functions.name: memory_search
functions.description: Semantic search over MEMORY.md and ~/memory/*.md. Returns top snippets with path and line citations like MEMORY.md#L7. Use before answering anything about prior work, dates, people, preferences, or history.

queries.description: 1 to 3 phrasings; queries[0] closest to the user's wording.

functions.name: memory_get
functions.description: Read lines from a memory file cited by memory_search.

path.description: Memory-relative path, e.g. MEMORY.md or memory/2026-09-10.md

functions.name: memory_explain
functions.description: Provenance for one memory claim: who said it, the quote, when first learned and last reinforced, current confidence, the earlier claims it replaced and the later ones that replaced it.

ref.description: A claim id, a memory:// URI, or a citation like memory/2026-09-09.md#L7

tool.description: Manage background shell sessions started with muse.exec background=true.

functions.name: list
functions.description: List background sessions with status.

functions.name: log
functions.description: Read recent output of a session.

functions.name: poll
functions.description: Check whether a session has finished and get its exit code.

functions.name: kill
functions.description: Terminate a session.

functions.name: write
functions.description: Write to a session's stdin.

functions.name: send_keys
functions.description: Send key presses to an interactive session (e.g. 'Enter', 'C-c').

tool.description: Delegate self-contained work to child agents that run in the background. Children start with no inherited transcript, so brief them fully. Results are delivered to you automatically; never poll.

functions.name: spawn
functions.description: Start a subagent on a task. Returns a spawn_id immediately.

message.description: The complete brief: goal, context, constraints, what to report back.

items.description: Optional multimodal items (text, image paths) in place of message.

label.description: Short human-readable label shown in the activity feed.

functions.name: list
functions.description: List subagents with status: running, done, interrupted, failed.

functions.name: send
functions.description: Send a follow-up message to a running subagent.

functions.name: resume
functions.description: Restart an interrupted subagent from where it stopped.

functions.name: close
functions.description: Stop a subagent and discard it.

tool.description: Your real Chromium. spawn_task starts an isolated browser worker on a natural-language task; steer_task continues one. search and open are fast read-only lookups.

functions.name: search
functions.description: Web search for public information. Returns results with titles, URLs, and snippets you can cite.

functions.name: open
functions.description: Fetch a page read-only and return its readable text with line numbers for citation.

functions.name: lookup_citation_url
functions.description: Resolve a citation marker from search or open results back to its exact URL.

functions.name: spawn_task
functions.description: Start a browser task worker. Give it the outcome you want, the starting URL if known, and what to report. Returns a task_id; the report arrives automatically.

allow_credentials.description: Whether the worker may request credential fills for sign-in (each fill still needs user approval).

functions.name: steer_task
functions.description: Send new instructions to a running or parked browser task.

functions.name: list_tasks
functions.description: List browser tasks and their status.

functions.name: stop_task
functions.description: Stop a browser task.

tool.description: Track open work items so nothing is dropped across interleaved messages and handoffs.

functions.name: write
functions.description: Replace the todo list.

functions.name: read
functions.description: Read the todo list.

functions.name: load_tool_namespace
functions.description: Load the full schemas for a deferred namespace so its functions can be called.
